hero.title: The way you interpret your surroundings... <highlight>deserves a story.</highlight>
hero.description: Storativa was created to develop the impulse that appears when something moves us, unsettles us, or sparks our curiosity. Here, you can transform a personal idea into a story to share.

emotion.title: Emotion
emotion.heading: Begin with something that moves you.
emotion.description: A concern, memory, or emotion can be the beginning of something that takes shape and develops into a new direction.

context.title: Context
context.heading: Reality can give shape to your idea.
context.description: Historical periods, places, and events provide context so imagination can find coherent ground.

voice.title: Your voice
voice.heading: Your vision is the center of the story.
voice.description: Storativa supports the process, but the essence, decisions, and meaning of the work belong to the author.

impulse.title: Something that awakens you
impulse.description: Concerns, memories, and feelings can be the initial purpose for embarking on a journey within the mind.

world.title: A world to explore
world.description: Every story starts from representative and symbolic elements based on the environment we understand and perceive.

message.title: A message that endures
message.description: Storativa lays the foundations and helps create a distinctive style that highlights each author's own ideas.

routing.title: From what you feel to what you can tell.
routing.description: Creating a story does not always begin with a plot. Sometimes it begins with a question, an image, or an era that keeps calling to you.

stages.listen: Listen to the concern. Recognize what awakens your desire to write.
stages.context: Find the context. Explore the historical moment, place, and circumstances that nourish the idea.
stages.shape: Give it shape and share it. Build an original narrative that can connect with someone else.

conclusion.title: A story that makes an impact.
conclusion.description: Storativa is here to help you discover what you want to tell, find the words, and turn your vision into a work that preserves your voice and creates connections with others.
